label: Russian
source_guidance: Interpret Russian inflection, verbal aspect, patronymics and forms of address, preserving their relationship information.
target_guidance: Use natural Russian with correct Cyrillic spelling, inflection, verbal aspect and forms of address. Do not transliterate into Latin letters without a reason.
punctuation_rule: Follow Russian publishing conventions for quotes, dashes and punctuation. Preserve symbol structure, repetition and pairing.
title_rule: Use conventional Russian titles and section labels.
term_guidance: Leave reading empty unless there is explicit pronunciation evidence.
